source: us-gaap tag candidates per canonical field, verified against the universe's SEC XBRL companyfacts on 2026-09-19; selection is per fiscal period because tags change between years (Apple's Revenues stops at FY2018, Microsoft's at FY2010, Allstate's IncurredClaimsPropertyCasualtyAndLiability at FY2023, Bank of America's PaymentsOfDividends at FY2013)
notes: Only annual facts: form in annual_forms with fp = FY; a duration fact must span annual_span_days because fp = FY also marks quarters; a balance must carry no start; the latest filing wins per fiscal year end.
A canonical field the map cannot supply for a period stays null and the valuation fails naming it; there is no per-field fallback to the vendor feed.
cash, total_debt, delta_nwc and ebit are not here: they follow reference/field_definitions.json, the one definition applied to both providers.
depreciation_amortization: the aggregate tags first; when none is filed, Depreciation plus AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets where filed (Microsoft and Alphabet file only these), labelled as the sum.

dividends_paid: the common-stock payments tag, then total payments (common and preferred, as JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley file them), then PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends (Bank of America 9.56bn FY2025: its PaymentsOfDividends stops at FY2013 and it never files PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock), then the declared-dividend tags; the tag matched is recorded per period.

cross_check_threshold 0.02 is an assumption: two providers reading the same filing under the same definitions should agree to within rounding; a larger gap is a vendor row that is wrong, lagging or built from another filed line, and the summary lists it.
